schinese.name: 伪子：排除万难
schinese.description: 以伪子身份，持有 10 个魔咒完成一局游戏。

english.name: CHEF: Dying to Meet You
english.description: As CHEF, complete Soulbound Threshold before the 4th Teleporter event.

schinese.name: 主厨：死也要见你
schinese.description: 以主厨身份，在第 4 次传送器事件之前完成魂缚之阈。

english.name: Artificer: One Giant Leap
english.description: As Artificer, reach the final boss on the moon without activating a pillar.

schinese.name: 奥术师：一大步
schinese.description: 以奥术师身份，在不激活任何柱子的情况下抵达月球上的最终 首领。

english.name: Commando: Retribution
english.description: As Commando, defeat the final boss after earning 8 karma.

schinese.name: 指挥官：报应
schinese.description: 使用指挥官，在获得8点业力后击败最终首领。

english.name: Engineer: Mad Scientist
english.description: As Engineer, repair an Equipment Drone with an Escape Pod's Fuel Array.

schinese.name: 工程师：疯狂科学家
schinese.description: 使用工程师，用逃生舱的燃料阵列修理一台装备无人机。

english.name: Huntress: Tomb Raider
english.description: As Huntress, obtain an Artifact from the Bulwark's Ambry in 25 minutes or less.

schinese.name: 女猎手：古墓丽影
schinese.description: 使用女猎手，在25分钟内从壁垒圣龛中获得一件神器。

english.name: REX: Invasive Growth
english.description: As REX, beat the game with at least 5 different Lunar items.

schinese.name: REX：入侵性生长
schinese.description: 使用REX，携带至少5种不同的月球物品通关游戏。

english.name: Acrid: Miracle
english.description: As Acrid, beat the game after sequencing your items at least once.

schinese.name: 酸液：奇迹
schinese.description: 使用酸液，在至少重新排列一次物品后通关游戏。
